field_title: Boar's Head Provisions Co. Recalls Ready-To-Eat Liverwurst Products Due to Possible Listeria Contamination
field_product_items: 3.5-lb. loaves of "Boar's Head Strassburger Brand Liverwurst Made in Virginia" with sell-by dates 10/15/2026 through 10/30/2026. UPC 0 42421 05505 1.
field_summary: Boar's Head Provisions Co., a Jarratt, Va. establishment, is recalling approximately 207,528 pounds of ready-to-eat liverwurst products that may be adulterated with Listeria monocytogenes.

field_title: FSIS Issues Public Health Alert for Frozen Chicken Fried Rice Products Due to Misbranding and Undeclared Allergen
field_processing: Heat Treated - Not Fully Cooked - Not Shelf Stable
field_product_items: 22-oz. bags of "Golden Wok Chicken Fried Rice" with lot code 2426A. UPC 0 71234 56789 2.
field_summary: FSIS is issuing a public health alert because the product contains egg, a known allergen, which is not declared on the label. A recall was not requested because the product is no longer available for purchase.
